messages.content: Just some text without any clear question or instruction. Random thoughts scattered across the page. Words floating. Nothing in particular. The morning was grey. The clock ticked. Tea was cold. Letters lay unopened. A bridge in the distance. The river kept going. Folds of cloth. Lamps lit and then unlit. Birds passed. Rain hesitated. Stone remembered nothing. The sky tilted. Pines stood. Dusk arrived without ceremony.
